source: RFC 0011 D2 (round 2 review of host and tools, M1)
statement: The starter's startup checks run whatever spring.main.lazy-initialization says: every module check (STA-1), the actuator endpoint check (STA-2), the eviction policy check and monitor (SNP-3), the replica read check (RC1-47), the API key membership check (IDN-6), the pipeline mode check, the unknown property check and the control plane's own-authorization check fail startup under lazy initialization as they do without it, and the components that keep watching once the host runs (the eviction policy monitor, shadow reporting, control-plane maintenance, the listeners' metrics) start at startup. Each of them is a StartupTask bean, which lazy initialization never defers; no auto-configuration of the starter declares one any other way. A configuration none of them refuses starts under lazy initialization.
